summary: H.R. 6120, known as the Strengthening Resources for our Schools Act or the SROS Act, amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to exempt certain retirement income from gross income for retired law enforcement officers and military members who work as school resource officers.

affected_groups.effect: Individuals who retired from the Armed Forces or as a law enforcement officer and subsequently work as school resource officers can exclude their retirement income from gross income while employed in that role, or for life if they complete at least 10 years as a school resource officer.
affected_groups.group: Retired Law Enforcement Officers and Military Members

affected_groups.effect: Agencies must provide notice to the Secretary regarding the start and end dates of qualifying individuals' employment as school resource officers.
affected_groups.group: Law Enforcement Agencies Employing School Resource Officers

key_provisions: Excludes retirement income from gross income for individuals working as school resource officers during the taxable years they are so employed, provided they retired from the Armed Forces or as a law enforcement officer.
Requires qualifying individuals to have successfully cleared background checks and to comply with state peace officer standards and training agency requirements.

Grants a lifetime exemption from gross income for retirement income received after employment as a school resource officer has ended, provided the individual served in that role for at least 10 years.
Requires the head of any law enforcement agency employing a qualifying school resource officer to provide the Secretary with notice of the initial employment start date and the end date.
Applies penalties for failing to file the required notices regarding school resource officer employment.
Directs the Secretary to prescribe necessary regulations or guidance within 180 days of enactment.
missing_information: The total fiscal cost or revenue impact of the tax exemption.
The exact number of individuals who would qualify for or benefit from the tax exclusion.
summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 6120, known as the Strengthening Resources for our Schools Act or the SROS Act, amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to exempt certain retirement income from gross income for retired law enforcement officers and military members who work as school resource officers.
summary_detail.significance: The bill provides tax relief on retirement income for former military members and law enforcement officers who take on school resource officer positions, aiming to incentivize their employment in schools.
